title: The Tale of Kaelen Ashthorn in The Shattered Realm of Aethelgard

character.name: Kaelen Ashthorn
character.bio: A disgraced warden of the Citadel who bound an unstable lightning prism into a notched silver broadsword.

history.author: Narrator
history.text:
An abandoned dreadnought skyship drifts out of the perpetual thunderclouds above Cloudpeak Port. Its distress beacon pulses with ancient violet light.

The Shattered Realm of Aethelgard awaits your decision.
suggestedActions: I steer my skiff toward the dreadnought's open cargo bay and secure my grapple rope.

history.author: Narrator
history.text:
Responding to your intent, Venture down the primary path. The atmosphere shifts immediately as the consequences unfold across the scene.

A gentle resonance hums through the crystalline leylines in the stonework. High above, archipelagos float against the clear sky like silent sentinels.

A new detail comes into focus, revealing an unexpected opportunity to investigate or press forward.
suggestedActions: Examine the immediate surroundings for hidden details.
Formulate a response utilizing your gear.
Speak with any nearby observers or companions.
Advance further along the primary pathway.
